Import a play-level scorecard CSV

Source: R/import_scorecards.R
import_scorecards.Rd

Read the standard dAImond Inning Plays CSV, retaining review information. The original file is not modified. One file represents one game, possibly containing both teams. Custom exports must retain the original required column names. Player names identify players only within a game and team.

Usage

import_scorecards(path, game_id)

Arguments

path

Path to one UTF-8 CSV file.

game_id

A nonempty character identifier supplied by the caller. Use the same identifier for both teams in a game and different identifiers for different games.

Value

A data frame with character columns game_id, team, player, inning, and play, numeric confidence, and logical needs_review. Inning labels such as 8+ are retained. Confidence may be missing; missing confidence forces review. Header-only files return zero rows.

Details

Required CSV columns are Team, Player, Inning, Play, Confidence, and Needs Review. Confidence is a number between zero and one. Review values may be Yes/No, TRUE/FALSE, or 1/0; a blank flag means false, matching the app export. Extra columns are ignored.

Human-readable play labels are converted to the app's canonical labels. Unknown plays and bad crops raise errors instead of being treated as outs. Explicit no_at_bat and automatic-runner markers are retained but excluded by calculate_batting_stats(). The upstream CSV exporter omits blank and bad-crop cells, so this function cannot detect those omitted readings.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "demo_plays.csv", package = "daimondstats")
plays <- import_scorecards(path, game_id = "demo-01")
head(plays)
#>   game_id      team    player inning          play confidence needs_review
#> 1 demo-01 Demo Owls Alex Demo      1        single       0.99        FALSE
#> 2 demo-01 Demo Owls Alex Demo      3        double       0.98        FALSE
#> 3 demo-01 Demo Owls Alex Demo      5      home_run       0.99        FALSE
#> 4 demo-01 Demo Owls Alex Demo      7     strikeout       0.97        FALSE
#> 5 demo-01 Demo Owls Alex Demo      8          walk       0.98        FALSE
#> 6 demo-01 Demo Owls Alex Demo     8+ sacrifice_fly       0.96        FALSE
